task_completion.description: Load the cytochrome_c_multispecies.fasta file into UGENE.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE interface showing the 'cytochrome_c_multispecies.fasta' file opened, displaying 8 sequence entries in the project view or sequence viewer.

task_completion.description: Perform a multiple sequence alignment using the MUSCLE algorithm.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The MUSCLE alignment dialog box being configured or a progress bar for the MUSCLE algorithm, followed by the sequences appearing aligned with gaps in the editor.

task_completion.description: Generate a pairwise identity/distance matrix within UGENE.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Statistics' or 'Distance Matrix' tab/window open in UGENE showing a grid of percentage identity or distance values for the 8 species.

task_completion.description: Export the alignment to ~/UGENE_Data/results/cytc_alignment.sto in Stockholm format.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export as Alignment' or 'Save As' dialog box with the file format set to 'Stockholm' and the destination path pointing to the results folder.
The export dialog for the distance matrix showing the CSV format and the correct file path in the results directory.

task_completion.description: Document findings in a report at ~/UGENE_Data/results/cytc_analysis_report.txt including specific metrics.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing the content of 'cytc_analysis_report.txt' containing the sequence count (8), alignment length (112), and specific species comparisons (e.g., Horse/Pig similarity, Human/Pig conservation).

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the UGENE GUI rather than just command-line tools.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the UGENE application window, menus, and internal tool dialogs (MUSCLE, Distance Matrix) being interacted with by the cursor.

integrity.description: Ensure the agent didn't just create empty files or placeholder text.
integrity.visual_evidence: The report and exported files must contain data consistent with the 8 sequences (e.g., alignment length 112) rather than generic or empty content.

integrity.description: Check that the agent derived the values from the software interaction.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent should be seen opening the Statistics/Distance Matrix view in UGENE to read the values before typing them into the report.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset contains 8 UniProt sequences. The MUSCLE alignment length is 112 positions. The most similar species pair is Horse (P00004) and Pig (P62895) at ~97.1% identity. The most divergent pair is Cannabis (P00053) and Yeast (P00044) at ~51.4% identity. Relative to Human (P99999), the Pig (P62895) is the most conserved animal model at ~90.5% identity. The agent must use the UGENE GUI for these calculations.
